property_summary: The reference contract never allows fallback to succeed when msg.value is not exactly 10 ether, so a deposit with any other amount reverts; the mutant allows deposits of less than 10 ether to succeed and (if block.number%15==0) to transfer the contract's entire balance, causing extra loss of funds.
change_summary: Remove the msg.value check entirely, allowing the function to succeed with any or no ether sent, changing the transfer/deposit behavior.
